name: When should I consider a full bathroom renovation instead of a partial update?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full bathroom renovation instead of a partial update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a full bathroom renovation if your current bathroom has significant functional issues, such as outdated plumbing, persistent leaks, or a layout that no longer meets your needs. It's also a good choice if you're looking to significantly increase your home's value or if the existing aesthetic is severely dated and you desire a complete transformation. Partial updates are better for minor cosmetic changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for a full renovation when facing major functional issues, aiming for significant value increase, or desiring a complete aesthetic transformation.
